reviewHistory.finding: Resolved prediction-map records retained unchecked grade fields. A losing pick with winnerCorrect as a truthy string rendered a false correct/exact badge.
reviewHistory.resolution: Modern resolved records validate their complete grading fields. Actual S78 winner-only records remain compatible and ungraded; contradictory modern grades are discarded without re-counting.

reviewHistory.finding: When a self-consistent stored grade contradicted the current game and writes failed, deletion was lost and the next read restored the stale correct/exact badge.
reviewHistory.resolution: A bounded per-Storage/week pending overlay retains updates and invalidation tombstones. Successful reread merges pending changes before retry, and denied aggregate reads refuse unknown-data overwrite.

concreteReproduction.scenario: Save NYJ24-BUF10 correct/exact receipt, change current authoritative game to BUF24-NYJ10, deny writes, resolve and reload/render the prediction map.

observations: Corrupt containers, entries, counters and journals are rejected without inventing grades.
Pending map state is isolated by Storage identity and week/league key; failed map settlement does not emit another same-tab receipt.
Successful reread preserves durable neighboring picks when retrying pending changes.
Actual S78 legacy schema was independently confirmed from revision f29ddb34 and remains readable without new margin grades or double-counting.
Existing normal grading, isolation, idempotence and frozen input immutability checks pass.
